newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends down $2 but off lows, Brent weak.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends down $2 but off lows, Brent weak.

text.p: IPE gas oil recovered in late trading to end down $2 a tonne at $167 on the March contract.
The contract was at $165.75 just 10 minutes before the close after tracking a slide of 45 cent a barrel in Brent futures.
April Brent was down 23 cents at $19.63 at 1733 GMT having peaked at $19.90. Weak wet Brent and the NYMEX sinking into contango had undermined market confidence.

The April-May spread was about 13 cents a barrel compared to a close of 19 cents last Friday. But April expires at the end of this week leaving the May-June spread, currently trading at seven cents, to underpin the front end of the crude curve.
Dealers said support on April was near $19.15 a barrel and then at $18.68 the low hit a week.
European refinery margins remained in the doldrums despite run cuts at some refiners and good trade support for gasoline ahead of the summer driving season.
Demand for gasoline in Saudi Arabia encouraged some buying in Rotterdam but gas oil and heavy fuel remained sluggish.

Wet Brent swaps were talking a cent or two below the Brent futures from April onwards, said brokers. But gas oil to Brent crack spread swaps were little changed around $4.25 a barrel in the third quarter and $4.90 on the fourth.
